exclusions: none; any invalid/missing target, training integrity failure or engine failure aborts entire decision, no performance-based exclusion
past_data_reuse: retrospective reused V4 development data; no untouched validation, no future predictive edge claim
random_generator: NumPy PCG64, first8 big-endian SHA256(seed|historical_target|t); uniform sample via random45 argpartition6; unique candidate prefixes max37; same greedy overlap<=2 and exact fallback; no actual outcome in generation
selected_lines: copy three rows of selected mode from sealed FINAL_THREE_LINES only, no mixing
statistical_tests: paired nonoverlapping10-target block sign-flip Monte Carlo two-sided + Holm4; circular10-target block bootstrap95%; exact McNemar secondary
support_gate: positive paired 3+,4+,mean deltas, all three Holm p<.05 and bootstrap CI excludes0 in same direction; nonnegative max delta; positive overall random 3+/4+/mean; all4 blocks nonnegative random3+/mean and paired3+/mean; otherwise deterministic tie-break
tie_break: lower population variance of four50-block portfolio3+ rates, exact integer numerator /40000
training: frozen engine fit/candidates/portfolio, expanding1..t-1 and rolling last300; prospective predict/load guards are not modified
